earnings.title: Enbridge Reports Strong Second Quarter Results, Reaffirms 2026 Guidance and Grows Secured Backlog to $41B
highlights: Distributable cash flow (DCF)* of $2.9 billion, in-line with results in 2025
We are advancing projects all across our businesses and in the second quarter added $1 billion to our now $41 billion growth project backlog.
outlook: The Company reaffirms its 2026 financial guidance for adjusted EBITDA between $20.2 billion and $20.8 billion and DCF per share between $5.70 and $6.10.
The Company also reaffirms its post-2026 adjusted EBITDA, DCF per share, and EPS near-term average compound annual growth rate of approximately 5%.
Enbridge added over $1 billion to its secured growth backlog through the sanctioning of the Line 5 Relocation project.
The secured growth backlog now sits at approximately $41 billion.
